explanations: call_with_retry() defaults retry_on to GatewayError, the base class of every gateway failure, so permanent errors such as InvalidNumber are retried exactly like timeouts. A request that can never succeed is resubmitted with backoff until the attempts run out, burning provider quota and making the user wait. Only TransientError (timeouts, rate limits, 5xx) is worth retrying, so the default becomes TransientError, which lets InvalidNumber propagate on the first attempt with no sleep. send_otp() already maps that exception to an 'invalid_number' result.
